prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction.
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no tests resulted in a statistically significant win.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow), path redesigns (choose_path, redesign), adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), and finish screens (finish, new_screen), as each has only 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for new home flows, path selection redesigns, or photo upload split layout redesigns.
Predictions were consistently too high and overly optimistic across tests, such as predicting a +20.0% gain for sign-in reordering and +4.0% for a finish screen that performed significantly worse.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -5.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Companion Traits Layout: Switch the friend picker screen to a two-column layout displaying pet personality traits alongside companion previews. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a median time of 89s; displaying traits side-by-side helps users evaluate choices faster.)
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Stage Interactive Tip Carousel: Add an interactive tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining how to interact with the pet on desktop. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s, and support logs show users are confused about how to control or talk to the pet later.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Companion Desktop Quickstart Guide Screen: Insert a new quickstart introduction screen after home_intro demonstrating basic desktop mouse shortcuts and pet interactions. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or interact with pets post-onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Recovery Hint: Display explicit hint text on the sign-in screen explaining that signing into an existing account restores previously adopted pets. (why: Support logged 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Dual Column Layout: Update the choose_path screen layout to a two-column format contrasting preset companions against custom creation. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s, showing users hesitate when evaluating path options.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Stage Background Notification Opt-In: Add a desktop notification toggle switch to the waiting screen so users can be alerted when pet generation finishes. (why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s; allowing desktop alerts keeps users engaged without forcing them to stare at the screen.)
6: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Guidance Intro Screen: Add an introductory guidance screen before choose_path detailing what each path offers. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion early in the journey.)

scores.note: Adoption has high drop-off (60.9%), but evidence relies only on funnel duration without support log confirmation.
Both funnel wait time and support logs point to user confusion on home screen interactions.
New finish screens previously backfired (-5.1% lift); adding a screen increases friction and requires a full release.
Supported directly by 8 support emails and sign-in drop-offs; low cost text/hint update.
Choose path redesign showed slight past improvement (+2.0%), but evidence is limited to funnel duration.
Addresses long waiting duration (2336s mean), though support logs do not explicitly request notifications.
Adding introductory screens creates extra friction and requires high effort with unproven benefit.
